---
title: "DUX4r methylation comparison by sample"
output:
  html_document:
    df_print: paged
---

This report follows the import and methylation comparison workflow in
`repo4.2_methylation_comparison_export_pdf.Rmd` for all files in `annotated/`.
The original ROI BED is not present in this project, so the comparable DUX4
region subset below is defined by gene names containing `DUX4` (for example,
`DUX4L51`).

## Import annotated files

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)

data_dir <- "annotated"
files <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = "_methylation_mean\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)
if (length(files) == 0) stop("No annotated methylation files found in ", data_dir)

read_annotated_file <- function(file) {
  filename <- basename(file)
  match <- stringr::str_match(
    filename,
    "^(.*)_reads_(with|without)_DUX4r_methylation_mean\\.txt$"
  )
  if (anyNA(match[1, 2:3])) {
    stop("Unexpected annotated filename format: ", filename)
  }

  readr::read_tsv(
    file,
    col_names = c("chromosome", "start", "end", "gene", "methylation_mean"),
    col_types = readr::cols(
      chromosome = readr::col_character(),
      start = readr::col_integer(),
      end = readr::col_integer(),
      gene = readr::col_character(),
      methylation_mean = readr::col_double()
    ),
    comment = "#",
    show_col_types = FALSE
  ) |>
    mutate(sample = match[1, 2], status = match[1, 3])
}

all_data <- purrr::map_dfr(files, read_annotated_file)

dplyr::count(all_data, sample, status, name = "regions")
```

Each imported row receives `sample` (the filename prefix before `_reads_`)
and `status` (`with` or `without`).

## Select DUX4-associated regions

```{r}
roi = read.table(paste0("DUX4_ROI.bed"),header = FALSE,stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

dux4_data <- all_data |>
  filter(gene %in% roi$V4) |>
  filter(!is.na(methylation_mean))

# dux4_data <- all_data |>
#   filter(stringr::str_detect(gene, regex("DUX4", ignore_case = TRUE))) |>
#   filter(!is.na(methylation_mean))

if (nrow(dux4_data) == 0) {
  stop("No rows with DUX4 in the gene name were found. Check the intended ROI.")
}

dux4_data |>
  group_by(status) |>
  summarise(
    regions = n(),
    mean_methylation = mean(methylation_mean),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## Compare paired sample means

The plot and test use one mean per sample and status. Samples without both
statuses are excluded from the paired test.

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
sample_means <- dux4_data |>
  group_by(sample, status) |>
  summarise(mean_methylation = mean(methylation_mean), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(status = factor(status, levels = c("without", "with")))

paired_means <- sample_means |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = status, values_from = mean_methylation) |>
  filter(!is.na(without), !is.na(with)) |>
  mutate(difference = with - without)

cat("Complete paired samples:", nrow(paired_means), "\n")
p_value_label <- NULL
mean_label <- NULL

if (nrow(paired_means) >= 2) {
  cat("Mean paired difference (with - without):",
      mean(paired_means$difference), "\n")
  cat("Median paired difference (with - without):",
      median(paired_means$difference), "\n")

  # Primary test: paired t-test across samples. The independent units are
  # samples/patients, not the individual genomic regions.
  paired_t_test <- t.test(
    paired_means$with,
    paired_means$without,
    paired = TRUE
  )
  print(paired_t_test)
  p_value_label <- paste0(
    "Paired t-test: p = ",
    format.pval(paired_t_test$p.value, digits = 3, eps = 0.001)
  )
  mean_label <- paste0(
    "Mean: <span style='color:#F8766D'>",
    formatC(mean(paired_means$without), format = "f", digits = 2),
    "</span> vs <span style='color:#00BFC4'>",
    formatC(mean(paired_means$with), format = "f", digits = 2),
    "</span>"
  )

  # Rank-based sensitivity test; interpret cautiously when there are few pairs.
  paired_wilcox_test <- wilcox.test(
    paired_means$with,
    paired_means$without,
    paired = TRUE,
    exact = FALSE
  )
  print(paired_wilcox_test)
} else {
  message("Fewer than two samples have both statuses; paired tests not calculated.")
}

paired_plot <- ggplot(sample_means,aes(y=status,x=mean_methylation,fill=status,group = sample))+
  geom_line(alpha = 0.45, colour = "grey55") +
  geom_point(aes(colour = status), size = 3) +
  {if (!is.null(p_value_label)) annotate(
    "text", y = 2.5, x = 50, label = p_value_label,
    size = 7, vjust = 1
  )} +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = c(without = "DUX4 loci from reads without DUX4r", with = "DUX4 loci from reads with DUX4r")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(without = "#F8766D", with = "#00BFC4")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(without = "#F8766D", with = "#00BFC4")) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(
    y = NULL,
    x = "Mean methylation score",
    colour = "Status",
    caption = mean_label
  ) +

  theme_classic()+
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, linewidth=1),
        axis.text = element_text(size=20),
        axis.title = element_text(size=20),
        legend.position = "none",
        plot.caption = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 14, hjust = 0.5))

paired_plot


```

## Export figure to PDF

This section saves the paired sample-means plot, including the paired t-test
p-value, as an 8 × 6 inch PDF in the current working directory.

```{r, eval=TRUE}



ggsave(
  filename = "repo4.3_DUX4r_methylation_comparison.pdf",
  plot = paired_plot,
  device = grDevices::cairo_pdf,
  width = 8,
  height = 3,
  units = "in"
)
```
